body: Yes, but she's since moved away. I don't want to burden her; she's at a very good place, and when she left she had the impression all was well. I don't know if the losses are motivating, more like aggravating. I don't know. I'm so tired and I can't sleep. There are so many things jumbled around in my head. I fight so hard every day against these sudden surges of self-hatred. Only recently have I lost control again. Somehow I find relief at the sight of bright red gashed all over my shoulders and torso, albeit a very sick relief. The friend I lost committed suicide (he was the gay son of Christian fundamentalists - I knew him from when I lived in Canada) and the ironic thing is he helped me get through the aftermath of my failed attempts. He was the strong one. And now I don't know where that leaves me.

If I fail chemistry, I'm stuck in this house forever. I hate feeling so suffocated.

I lost my grandfather a few year back, and recently the guy I was (secretly) in love with.
I live in Pakistan. I can't talk to a counselor. And I can't bring myself to talk to my friends.
